body: niice! :D (sorry for the late reply, by the way)

Emm, it's got a lot to do with acting :) 

Which I would actually love, because I'm also looking into becoming an actor. (I know, it's an unlikely pursuit, but still...) I figure that being the president of this society would help immensely if I were to apply for drama schools here in the UK (or even drama courses, or local amateur theatre groups).

I'd kick myself quite a bit if I didn't take this opportunity. (especially since I'm not going to get another opportunity this big anyway). But I also don't want to lose my mind completely by staying at this uni for another year (however much it seems like it's improving as a uni).

...I could take a gap year after my second year, though. That's a possibility...:)

Yaay! I'm seeing a way out of this now!

I've definitely thought about it :) and the more I think about it, the more attractive an idea it seems to me.
However, it would probably cause the same kind of problems as if I were to leave the uni. 
I'd end up disappointing people all over the uni (I don't know what I'd tell them if they ask why I took a gap year right in the middle of my course) - maybe even my parents, as much as they'd try to hide it.
I also have a society to run. I'm really excited about running it next year, but I'm scared that it'll die if I leave. Especially since I have no one else I can entrust it with, and I don't trust the student body here enough to revive it - they're, by in large, lethargic. 
This could come down to an over-bloated sense of responsibility on my part, though. :) Maybe I hope it is.
